name: Dashboard Summary
author: Rejaul Alom Khan

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress admin dashboard with beautiful, modern gradient cards that display key metrics at a glance. Dashboard Summary provides a visually stunning way to monitor your WooCommerce store and blog performance without navigating away from your main admin area.

✨ Key Features

🎨 Beautiful Design
– Colorful Gradient Cards: Modern gradient backgrounds with 6 unique color schemes
– Customizable Colors: Full control over card gradient colors via settings page
– Professional Icons: Clean, modern icons with glassmorphism effects
– Smooth Animations: Hover effects and smooth transitions for better UX

📊 WooCommerce Statistics
– Total Orders with quick link to orders page
– Pending/Processing Orders tracking
– Completed Orders count
– On-Hold Orders monitoring
– Total Customers overview
– Product Count display

📝 Blog Statistics
– Total Posts published
– Total Pages created
– Comments count
– Categories overview
– Tags summary
– User count

⚙️ Advanced Settings
– Toggle WooCommerce and Blog summaries independently
– Professional toggle switches (iOS-style)
– Color picker for each card (start and end gradient colors)
– Live gradient preview
– Reverse color system: WooCommerce uses colors 1-6, Blog uses 6-1

📱 Fully Responsive
– Desktop: 6 cards per row (large screens), 4 cards per row (medium screens)
– Tablet: 3 cards per row with optimized spacing
– Mobile: 2 cards per row with compact design
– Adaptive font sizes and padding for all screen sizes

🔗 Smart Navigation
– All cards are clickable and link to relevant admin pages
– Direct access to orders, products, posts, pages, comments, etc.
– Seamless navigation without leaving dashboard context

🎯 Perfect For

  • WooCommerce store owners who want quick insights
  • Blog administrators monitoring content metrics
  • Agency owners managing multiple sites
  • Anyone who wants a beautiful, functional dashboard

🌐 Translation Ready

Fully localized with text domain ‘dashboard-summary’. Ready for translation into any language.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to WordPress admin panel → Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Dashboard Summary”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Navigate to Settings → Dashboard Summary to customize colors and options

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dashboard-summary directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  4. Go to Settings → Dashboard Summary to configure

After Installation

  1. Visit your WordPress dashboard to see the beautiful cards
  2. Customize card colors from Settings → Dashboard Summary
  3. Enable/disable WooCommerce or Blog summaries as needed
  4. (Optional) Ensure WooCommerce is active for store statistics
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce for this plugin to work?

No! The Blog Summary works independently. WooCommerce Summary will only display if WooCommerce is installed and active.

How do I customize the card colors?

Go to Settings → Dashboard Summary. You’ll find color pickers for each of the 6 cards. Choose start and end colors for beautiful gradients. Changes apply immediately after saving.

Can I change the order of colors?

Yes! The plugin uses a smart reverse color system. WooCommerce cards use colors 1-6 in normal order, while Blog cards use colors 6-1 in reverse order for visual variety.

Are the cards clickable?

Absolutely! Each card is a clickable link that takes you directly to the relevant admin page (orders, products, posts, comments, etc.).

Is it mobile responsive?

Yes! The plugin is fully responsive:
– Desktop: Up to 6 cards per row
– Tablet: 3 cards per row
– Mobile: 2 cards per row
All with optimized font sizes and spacing.

Can I disable certain features?

Yes, use the toggle switches in Settings → Dashboard Summary to enable/disable WooCommerce and Blog summaries independently.

Will it slow down my dashboard?

No! The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance. Statistics are loaded efficiently only when viewing the dashboard.

Can I translate it to my language?

Yes! The plugin is translation-ready with text domain ‘dashboard-summary’. Use any translation plugin like Loco Translate.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes! The plugin works with any WordPress theme as it’s added to the admin dashboard area.
